# Vespa UI

> Self-hosted admin console for Vespa — search, inspect, debug, and monitor Vespa clusters from a single web interface, with credentials kept server-side.

Vespa UI is open source (Apache 2.0), built with NestJS, TypeORM, React, and Vite. It ships as a single Docker container with SQLite or PostgreSQL.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://vespa-ui.github.io/docs-raw/getting-started/introduction.md): What Vespa UI is, and who it's for.
- [Installation](https://vespa-ui.github.io/docs-raw/getting-started/installation.md): Run Vespa UI locally with pnpm, or in production with Docker.
- [Configuration](https://vespa-ui.github.io/docs-raw/getting-started/configuration.md): Environment variables used by the backend.
- [Overview](https://vespa-ui.github.io/docs-raw/architecture/overview.md): How the monorepo and the security model fit together.
- [Tech Stack](https://vespa-ui.github.io/docs-raw/architecture/tech-stack.md): Backend, frontend, and tooling choices.
- [Writing Documentation](https://vespa-ui.github.io/docs-raw/writing-docs.md): How this docs site turns committed Markdown files into pages.
